chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Zurarah, who said:
Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said: It is only disliked that a man combine between two weeks and two tawafs in the obligatory rite; as for the supererogatory rite, there is no problem.

key_terms.الْأُسْبُوعَيْنِ: two sets of seven circuits in tawaf
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection
key_terms.يُكْرَهُ: is considered disliked in legal ruling

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to combine two tawafs in obligatory tawaf but allowed in supererogatory tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding combining two circuits-sets of tawaf. It states that doing so in an obligatory context is disliked, while in a supererogatory context there is no objection. The narration therefore distinguishes between the rulings of obligatory and recommended acts in tawaf.
